scope: Enable one current-source visible timestamp task and its separately permitted fixed OS-isolated tests within the existing controller, source evidence, journal and provider.
riskAnalysis: Security-sensitive extension of fixed task execution. Exact immutable source, descriptor and replacement remain mandatory; all legacy tasks stay unchanged and cannot borrow the new profile. Actual fixture OS qualification and success/failure controller evidence precede release.

threatModel.assets: Source/task/release identity, existing OIDC credential isolation, one-use sandbox authority, immutable usage/failure/test receipts and original adoption history.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted model proposal to fixed validator/data copy, fresh owner companion test permission to existing CAS/provider, guest OS isolation to real application and Production.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged task/test profile, cross-workspace receipt replay, arbitrary source/command substitution, stale or duplicate grants, encoded output bombs, lost acknowledgments and cleanup failure.
threatModel.mitigations: Authenticated immutable descriptor/manifest and full preimage; WeakMap job provenance; exact source pair/argv; bounded codec; one-use scoped permission; serial guarded provider; mandatory stop/reconciliation; independent review and actual23controls.

rollback: Reviewed feature revert with paid flags off; preserve all new source/task/receipt evidence and do not reuse old approvals. Stop any unconfirmed session by its exact recorded name through existing cleanup authority.

defects.rootCause: Visible date/time formatters use truthiness instead of finite Date validity; backend source-test integration previously supported only Starter.
defects.detectionGap: Earlier bounded aria-label patch intentionally left visible spans unchanged; source test profile was deliberately unavailable for other tasks.
defects.regression: 205 related cases, full five-stage controller success/failure fixtures, actual7behavior/23isolation qualification, downstream selected-profile receipt checks and legacy diagnostic compatibility.
defects.historicalPrevention: Register exact current source/evidence/test profile together; exercise successful and failing test receipts through every later stage before paid dispatch.

defects.rootCause: A new development policy was registered in provider selection but omitted from separate lifecycle serial and UI journal membership lists.
defects.detectionGap: Happy-path controller fixtures bypassed the real UI and did not enumerate every active policy across component boundaries.
defects.regression: Registry-wide provider/UI/lifecycle parity, prepared-active-consumed serial denial for every active policy, and actual visible-policy UI Prepare/Run/revoke one-dispatch case;51checks passed.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep one server serial membership list and enumerate the provider registry in cross-component tests whenever adding a task policy; do not rely on a single happy-path workflow.
